core.title: Plan comparison and billing management
covers: confirmation of destructive or high-risk actions
core.guidance: Plans are a radio group of equal-width cards with the current plan marked in text (not colour only), prices with tabular figures and the billing period stated, a feature list with real text (no bare check marks without labels), and one primary action per state (Upgrade / Downgrade / Current); every card is one Tab stop with a visible focus ring, arrow keys move between plans; seat management is a data table (name, role, status, last active) with row actions reachable from the keyboard and a bulk selection state; invoice history is a table with date, amount (tabular), status text + icon and a real download link (not a hover-only icon); plan changes and seat removals confirm in a dialog that states the billing consequence and returns focus; billing settings sub-navigation is a vertical list with aria-current.
core.use_when: Billing/plan pages: choosing or changing a plan, seat management, invoice history, payment method.
core.avoid_when: Public pricing marketing pages (hero + narrative) or checkout for a one-off purchase.

implementation.nextjs: Server component for the invoice table; client radio group for plans; shadcn Dialog with returnFocus; Table with <th scope> and numeric cells using tabular-nums.
implementation.react: role=radiogroup on the plan row; roving tabindex; download as <a download> with the file name in the link text.

core.title: Data table / grid
core.guidance: Sticky header, row height by density token, zebra striping optional (prefer hover/selection highlight), column resize/reorder/visibility persisted, sort indicator with aria-sort, selection checkbox column with header select-all and a count, row actions visible on focus as well as hover, inline edit with Enter/Escape, keyboard grid navigation (arrows, Home/End, PageUp/Down), virtualised rows, loading skeleton rows, empty state inside the table body. Financial tables: see numeric rule.
core.use_when: Homogeneous records with several comparable attributes; sorting, filtering, selection, bulk actions, inline editing.
core.avoid_when: Fewer than ~10 rows (use a list), heterogeneous items (use cards/list), phone widths (convert to rows).

implementation.react: TanStack Table (headless) + TanStack Virtual; render semantic <table> when static, role=grid when interactive; sticky via position: sticky on th.
implementation.shadcn: DataTable recipe (TanStack) is the convention; keep the Table primitives, add virtualisation for >200 rows.

guardrails.title: Actions only on hover
guardrails.guidance: Show on focus too, keep a visible affordance (overflow menu) for touch, and never on TV.
guardrails.use_when: Row actions, card menus, and edit buttons that appear only on mouse hover.
guardrails.selected_for: most relevant record for the request wording

guardrails.title: Grids with row actions are one Tab stop
guardrails.guidance: Tab enters the grid once and leaves it once; arrow keys move between cells/rows (roving tabindex or a focus manager), Enter/Space activates the focused cell's action, Escape returns from an edited cell to navigation mode; row actions become reachable when the row or actions cell is focused and are also available from a row context/actions menu; a table with 24 rows must never produce 24 Tab stops per action column. Announce the current row/column (aria-rowindex/colindex or the platform's automation properties) and keep a visible focus indicator on the active cell.
guardrails.use_when: Data tables or grids where each row has buttons/links (edit, delete, approve, download) and there are more than a handful of rows.
guardrails.avoid_when: Small static tables with no interactive cells.

implementation.react: role=grid with a roving tabindex hook; tabIndex=-1 on non-active cells; key handlers on the grid container.

guardrails.selected_for: most relevant record for the request wording

guardrails.title: Semantic structure: headings, landmarks, lists, tables
guardrails.guidance: Structure first, style second: choose the element for its meaning and restyle it. Data tables use <th scope>; layout tables are forbidden; visually hidden headings are fine for screen readers when the visual design omits them.
guardrails.use_when: Every page: one h1, ordered heading levels, main/nav/aside landmarks, real <button>/<a>/<table>, lists for lists.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never use divs with click handlers as buttons; never use heading levels for visual size.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: semantic structure and roles

guardrails.title: Text contrast 4.5:1 (3:1 large)
guardrails.guidance: Body and label text ≥4.5:1, large text (≥24 px or ≥19 px bold) ≥3:1, AAA target 7:1 for long reading and for TV. Measure with tokens.py contrast, never estimate. Placeholder text is text and must pass.
guardrails.use_when: Every text/background pair in every theme and every state (hover, pressed, selected, placeholder).
guardrails.avoid_when: Never skip; disabled text and pure decoration are the only exemptions.

guardrails.title: Accessible names for every control and image
guardrails.guidance: Visible label for inputs (not placeholder-only), aria-label/accessibilityLabel/contentDescription/AutomationProperties.Name for icon-only controls, alt text for meaningful images and alt="" for decorative ones, link text that makes sense out of context. The accessible name must contain the visible label text (label in name).
guardrails.use_when: Icon-only buttons, inputs, images, custom controls, links whose text is 'Read more'.
guardrails.avoid_when: Decorative images and icons beside visible text are hidden from assistive tech instead.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: accessible names and labels

guardrails.title: Design empty, loading, error, and partial states
guardrails.guidance: Empty: what this is, why it is empty, one action. Loading: skeleton with final dimensions, then content; announce completion. Error: what failed, what to do, retry that works; keep entered data. Partial: show what loaded, mark what didn't. On TV, focus must land somewhere valid in each state.
guardrails.use_when: Every list, table, chart, form, and detail screen.
guardrails.avoid_when: Never ship a blank area for empty data; never show a spinner for more than ~1 s without a skeleton or progress; never show an error without a next step.
guardrails.selected_for: required coverage: loading, empty and error states
